# Xenex Labs

> Xenex Labs is a Health Canada and FDA GMP-approved pharmaceutical compounding supplier offering APIs, compounding bases, and pharmacy solutions.

Xenex Labs operates globally with regional presence in North America and Australia, serving pharmacists and veterinarians with high-quality compounding ingredients, specialized bases, and suspension vehicles. The company is committed to regulatory compliance and sustainable practices.

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Bases](https://www.xenexlabs.com/collections/bases): Product catalog of transdermal and compounding bases including TD Lipo
- [Multimax](https://www.xenexlabs.com/pages/multimax): Transderma MultiMax versatile cream compounding base for skincare
- [XeneFix](https://www.xenexlabs.com/pages/xenefix): XeneFix pharmaceutical gel products for topical and dermatological use
- [TD Lipo](https://www.xenexlabs.com/pages/td-lipo): TD Lipo liposomal delivery system with clinical research validation
- [SuspendRx™ Anhydrous Suspension Vehicles](https://www.xenexlabs.com/pages/suspendrx%E2%84%A2-anhydrous-suspension-vehicles): SuspendRx oral suspension vehicles with taste-masking and stevia options
- [New Airless Pumps](https://www.xenexlabs.com/pages/new-airless-pumps): Airless pump packaging solutions with signature collection branding
